description: Validation result returned by major_minor_validator.py. The shape depends on whether all checked AOS are complete.

complete.description: True if every checked AOS is fully satisfied.

results.description: One entry per checked AOS (major and/or minor). Empty if neither was set.

code.description: The AOS code from the plan.

found.description: False if the code wasn't in the AOS database; in that case `complete` is false and a `message` field replaces the rest.

complete.description: Whether all requirement groups for this AOS are satisfied.

completed_cp.description: Sum of credit points for units in the schedule that map to this AOS's tree.

incomplete_groups.description: Empty when complete is true. Otherwise a list of failing groups.

group.description: Full path through the requirement tree, e.g. 'Part C > Core units'.

needed.description: How many units this group requires.

have.description: How many of the required units the student has scheduled.

missing_units.description: AND leaf nodes only — unit codes the student is missing.

options.description: OR leaf nodes only — remaining options the student could pick to satisfy the group.

of.description: OR branch nodes only — total number of children, where `needed` of `of` must be satisfied.

complete.message: All major and minor requirements are completed!

results.label: minor
results.message: Minor 'BOGUSCODE01' not found in AOS database

no_major_or_minor.message: No major or minor specified in the plan — nothing to validate.
